summary.zh-CN: 让每次 AI 运行都可追溯，并改善插话、子会话与长会话排队体验。
summary.en-US: Makes every AI run traceable and improves steering, child sessions, and queueing in long conversations.

body.zh-CN: 消息的更多操作会统一展示发起方、来源渠道、关联会话与消息、工具调用、来源模型和实际运行模型。
body.en-US: The message overflow menu shows the initiator, source channel, related session and message, tool call, source model, and effective run model.

body.zh-CN: 只有用户直接发起的后台任务弹出完成通知，Agent 委派、定时任务、观察任务和系统运行保持安静。
body.en-US: Only human-started background tasks show completion notifications; delegated, scheduled, observed, and system runs stay quiet.

body.zh-CN: 子会话继承父会话模型，不重复显示继承的压缩记录，并停止递归创建下一层会话。
body.en-US: Child sessions inherit the parent model, hide inherited compaction records, and no longer recursively create another level.

body.zh-CN: 插到下一步的消息在流式、完成和刷新后都会稳定排在当前步骤的 AI 输出之后。
body.en-US: Messages steered into the next step remain after the current AI output during streaming, after completion, and after reload.

body.zh-CN: 排队确认改为读取轻量会话摘要，不再复制完整历史。
body.en-US: Queue admission reads a lightweight session summary instead of copying the complete history.

body.zh-CN: 文件工具只保留一份结构化预览，同时继续显示错误与解析失败信息。
body.en-US: File tools keep one structured preview while preserving errors and parse-failure details.

body.zh-CN: 已有消息和会话保持可读；会话委派固定为一层。
body.en-US: Existing messages and sessions remain readable, while session delegation is limited to one level.
